title: Dev-ITS Workflow Configuration
description: Team and repo configuration for the dev-its-workflow skill. Place at .dev-its/config.json in your repo root.

reviewers.description: Team members who review PRs. Never add the PR author.

azure.description: Azure DevOps display name (for Azure repos)

backend.description: Detected from git remote. 'github' for github.com, 'azure-devops' for dev.azure.com

org.description: GitHub org or Azure DevOps org URL

project.description: Azure DevOps project name (not needed for GitHub)

base_branch.description: The branch PRs target (main, develop, etc.)

branch_prefix.description: Prefix for new branches (feature/, fix/, etc.)

gh_path.description: Path to the GitHub CLI binary (use full path if not on PATH)

az_path.description: Path to the Azure CLI binary

docker.description: Whether Docker is required for this project

gates.description: Which gates require human approval. Removing a gate is discouraged.

fast_track_enabled.description: Allow fast-track mode for LOW-complexity bug fixes

max_retries_per_stage.description: Max attempts per failing stage before escalating to human

max_test_review_loops.description: Max iterations of the test/review adversarial loop

parallel_tests.description: Run unit + integration tests in parallel

pr_template.description: Use 'built-in' for the included template, or a path to a custom template file
